message:
fix(apk): the decoder's detach is bounded -- 2 s per handoff, then the surface is BLOCKED and nothing of it released until the codec lets go; test-fixture relay and control-head trace (keepalive-r2 e, Codex apk-decoder-liveness r3 D1 D2)

D1 (Codex: not the unbounded UI wait of r1). nativeSetSurface now answers: > 0 done / taken, 0 refused,
< 0 a detach not done within its deadline (-seq). The UI waits at most kDetachDeadlineMs = 2000 for one
handoff and never again for a later detach while one is pending; RX and control never wait. While a
detach is pending no new surface is taken (refused, the window given straight back), and at most four
windows wait to be let go. nativeSurfaceReleasedSeq (lock-free) reaches the seq only once the codec of
that surface is stopped and deleted and its window let go.
Kotlin: a DetachDecoder that comes back pending stops the rest of its command batch (no StartRenderer /
BindDirect / Attach after it), keeps the Java Surface it had handed over, defers a renderer release
that came with it (the renderer's input is still fed), and leaves the surface BLOCKED
(SharpenPathPolicy.decoderDetachTimedOut). A watcher on the UI handler polls the released seq; the late
completion releases the held Surfaces, runs the deferred clean-up only -- never a bind; the blocked
surface stays blocked until it goes, a surface that came meanwhile waits for the next bind. A
SurfaceTexture destroyed while the decoder may hold it is returned false from onSurfaceTextureDestroyed
and released by the app once, when its last holder let go. A refused attach connects nothing
(decoderAttachRefused).

D2 (test builds / the local fixture only):
- the client's reliable head: UdpControlChannel::Stats gains the tx queue, the head's seq / attempts /
  first and last send, the last acked seq and when, ACKs taken / ignored, NACKs received (counters kept
  only with GNLINK_LIVENESS_TRACE) -- in the session's liveness_trace line beside the RX / control phases.
- the directory relay (server.js), with REMOTE60_RELAY_TRACE=1 only: per flow and direction, what
  arrived and what the socket said to our send, by header kind (video / ctlData / ctlAck / ctlNack /
  handshake / standby / unknown -- never a payload), in 1 s buckets on the process's monotonic clock
  with mono0 / wall0, the last times, refused host datagrams and host tuple changes; written at each
  5 s sweep and, with the buckets, at the close; unmatched c2h counted. Off: nothing counted, every send
  as before (an undefined callback).

Tests: android_decoder_liveness_test 40/40 (new [3]: create held 8 s -- the UI's detach back in 2.0 s
as pending, a second detach 0 ms, a new surface refused with its window given back, not reported done
while held, the late completion reported, it connects / feeds / configures nothing, then the next
surface is taken and used; RX / control < 50 ms throughout). NEGATIVE: mutant m4 (no deadline) 5 FAIL
(the UI held 12 s); the 9f9a91c sink 25 FAIL. SharpenPathPolicyTest 22/22 (5 new D1 cases); all Kotlin
unit tests (26 suites) 0 failures. Session, decoder, recv loop, prelogin 60, xbutton 75, role_park 13,
shared_core, idr_recovery 36, session_liveness 9 -- exit 0. relay_trace_test (new) ALL PASS x3 (off: no
trace line; on: both directions, clocks named, buckets at the close, no credential); one earlier off run
failed relay_test's grace-timing check once (replies=0), not again in 3 runs. The full directory suite
stops earlier at device_credential_test's old-server case, which fails the same at 9f9a91c.
APK: release (no liveness-trace marker), ke-off-lt / ke-on-lt (testDirectoryUrl + livenessTrace) built.
